gloss: to be absent-minded; to space out; to be vague

definitions.gloss: to be absent-minded; to space out; to be in a daze
definitions.explanation: Describes a person whose mind is not focused — daydreaming, zoning out, or not paying attention.

definitions.gloss: to be vague; to be hazy; to be indistinct
definitions.explanation: Describes things that are unclear or blurry — outlines, memories, shapes seen through fog.

examples.english: I was gazing absent-mindedly out the window.

notes:
An onomatopoeic word (⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧) that can function as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb or as an adverb. Very natural and common in everyday speech.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ぼんやりする: to zone out, be dazed
- ⟦ぼんやり→ぼんやり：03727_bonyari⟧（⟦と→と：00512_to⟧）: as an adverb (vaguely, absent-mindedly)
- ぼんやりした⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧: a vacant expression
- ぼんやりした⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧: a vague memory

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぼーっとする→ぼーっとする：26887_boottosuru⟧: to space out (very close; slightly more colloquial)
- ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be careless, do something absent-mindedly (implies a mistake)
- ⟦{曖昧|あいまい}→曖昧：08051_aimai⟧な: ambiguous, vague (more formal, for statements or situations)
